SELECT id, x FROM (VALUES (1, 'a', 2), (2, NULL, 4), (3, NULL, 4), (4, 'b', 1)) t(id, g, c)
        JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT g AS dg, c AS dc FROM (VALUES (1, 'a', 2), (2, NULL, 4), (3, NULL, 4), (4, 'b', 1)) s(id, g, c)) d
        ON t.g IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.dg AND t.c = d.dc
        DECIDE x(REAL) SUCH THAT x <= 9 AND sum(x) by (d) <= t.c MAXIMIZE sum(x)
